page_title: CAG 4-2 SAL | Cagliari v Salernitana 09/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Francesco Fourneau has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' The referee blows his whistle as Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) was too aggressive in his challenge.
90+4' Cagliari quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
87' Substitution. Toma Basic has come on for Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana).
87' The ball goes behind for a corner. Salernitana will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
85' What was Junior Sambia (Salernitana) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.

82' Great save! Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Guillermo Ochoa.
81' Simy (Salernitana) got on the ball on the edge of the box and blazed a first-time shot well over the bar.
80' Simy (Salernitana) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
79' Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) makes a strong challenge and Francesco Fourneau blows for a foul.
78' Salernitana take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
77' The substitution is prepared. Mateusz Wieteska (Cagliari) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Tommaso Augello.
76' 4 - 2 Goal! The rebound fell to Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari) and he fired home from close range. The score is 4:2.
74' Here is a change. Lassana Coulibaly is going off and Fabio Liverani gives the last tactical orders to Iron Gomis (Salernitana).
74' Substitution. Alessandro Zanoli walks off the pitch and Junior Sambia (Salernitana) comes on as a substitute.
73' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.

72' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Francesco Fourneau with no other option than to blow for a foul.
70' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) picks up a caution.
66' Substitution. Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari) on for Jakub Jankto.
66' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Gianluca Lapadula as he is replaced by Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari).
66' Claudio Ranieri prepares a substitution. Nahitan Nandez is replaced by Nicolas Viola (Cagliari).
65' It's time for a substitution. Simy (Salernitana) comes on in place of Shon Weissman.
62' Cagliari can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
58' 3 - 2 Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the right side of the goal. The score is 3:2.
58' The referee blows his whistle, Salernitana are awarded a corner kick.
56' 3 - 1 Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home low into the middle of the net. The goalkeeper was helpless.
54' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cagliari.
53' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
51' 3 - 0 Goal! Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari) has the simplest of tasks to roll the ball into an empty net from close range after a rebound left the keeper stranded. 3:0.
51' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Cagliari, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
50' The game is interrupted. Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
48' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
47' Francesco Fourneau couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) and blew his whistle.
46' Half-time substitution. Fabio Liverani decided to make a change. Konstantinos Manolas is replaced by Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana).
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Claudio Ranieri probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Gianluca Gaetano. He is replaced by Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Shon Weissman (Salernitana) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just wide of the left post. Unlucky!
45' Salernitana have been awarded a corner kick.
43' Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for a foul.
40' It's in the back of the net! Nahitan Nandez picks out Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) with a sweet pass, and he latches on to it deep inside the box and beats the goalkeeper. 2:0.
40' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Salernitana comes to nothing.
39' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Cagliari players look gutted.
38' The Cagliari players halt their celebrations as referee Francesco Fourneau makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
37' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) beats the offside trap and bears down on goal. With just the keeper to beat he coolly shoots past him from the edge of the box.
37' Shon Weissman (Salernitana) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player.
35' Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle. Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) commits a foul after dangerous play.
33' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
31' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
30' Jakub Jankto (Cagliari) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
29' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Francesco Fourneau blows for a foul.
28' Alessandro Zanoli (Salernitana) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
27' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
26' The corner is swung in but Cagliari can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
23' Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) commits a rough challenge and Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for an infringement.
21' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Yerry Mina (Cagliari) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar.
20' What a big chance! Jakub Jankto (Cagliari) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
18' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
14' 1 - 0 Referee Francesco Fourneau points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) goes wild in celebration.
13' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Francesco Fourneau wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
12' A goal, which was scored by Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari), was disallowed due to offside.

11' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
10' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
9' Rough tackle by Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
5' The ball is cleared after Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Salernitana.
3' Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the left post and behind for a goal kick.
2' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) commits a rough foul. Francesco Fourneau stops the game and makes a call.
1' The first half has started.
Cagliari will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Francesco Fourneau.
